runner: node <test-file>.test.js (no test framework/package.json in this repo; each *.test.js is a standalone Node script using assert + vm, matching the existing repo convention)

cases.name: base detection, WITH a CUENTAS (AM Intelligence) match and no contradictions -> DETECTED
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: a Retention signal with AM Intelligence context and no AM-activity red flags is never suppressed by default

cases.name: Sin dueno / house account -> SUPPRESSED / OWNER REQUIRED (regression), CUENTAS branch never touched
cases.guarantee: suppression: pre-existing owner-required rule still wins first and short-circuits before any new join logic runs

cases.name: cross-priority suppression (QNB beats Retention for the same account) -> HIGHER PRIORITY SIGNAL
cases.guarantee: suppression: shared v6ApplyPrioritySuppression_ still enforces one active family per account after adding the CUENTAS join

cases.name: bucket confirms genuine absence of management, no contradiction -> DETECTED
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: AM-activity evidence that clearly confirms no management does not block automated retention outreach

cases.name: ambiguous bucket ('8. GESTIONADAS SIN OPERAR') -> SUPPRESSED / AM ACTIVITY REVIEW REQUIRED, and v6PipelineWinner_/v6PipelineSyncSignals_ route it to CLOSED / SUPPRESSED like any other suppressed row
cases.guarantee: suppression + duplicate prevention: an ambiguous AM-activity signal never leaks into the active pipeline through the idempotent bulk pipeline sync

cases.name: bucket says 'no management' but Tipo gestion says COMERCIAL (contradiction) -> SUPPRESSED / AM ACTIVITY REVIEW REQUIRED
cases.guarantee: suppression: contradictory AM-activity evidence is flagged for human review instead of silently auto-detected or auto-suppressed

cases.name: row with no CUENTAS (AM Intelligence) match at all -> SUPPRESSED / AM CONTEXT REQUIRED, join coverage metric reflects partial match
cases.guarantee: canonical architecture: AURA never advances a NOVA-only signal to DETECTED by skipping AM Intelligence; a missing AM Intelligence record fails closed, and join coverage remains an observability metric on top of that gate, never a substitute for it

cases.name: REPLY -> pipeline RESPONDED, nextAction STOP ACCOUNT AUTOMATION / V5.5 HANDOFF, handoffStatus PENDING
cases.guarantee: stop + handoff: a real commercial reply stops account automation and creates an AM handoff via the existing pipeline stage machine

cases.name: RFQ -> pipeline RFQ RECEIVED with rfqAt set
cases.guarantee: response capture correctly advances pipeline stage for qualifying commercial activity

cases.name: BOUNCE -> MKT_CONTACTS_SECURE emailStatus INVALID via read-merge-upsert, historical fields preserved, pipeline untouched
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention / idempotent UPSERT (merge-by-contactId, never blind overwrite) and isolation (a delivery failure does not affect account pipeline state)

cases.name: UNSUBSCRIBE -> MKT_EXCLUSIONS ACTIVE exclusion with deterministic exclusionId, pipeline untouched
cases.guarantee: suppression / DNC governance: an unsubscribe becomes a durable, idempotent exclusion (re-processing the same event does not duplicate the exclusion row) without altering pipeline stage

cases.name: CLICK / OTHER / unrecognized eventType -> action IGNORED, zero writes to any table
cases.guarantee: normal-case automation: non-qualifying engagement events never trigger a stop, handoff, exclusion, or contact mutation

cases.name: resolves accountId via MKT_ACCOUNTS crosswalk and writes attributedRevenue exactly equal to Monto
cases.guarantee: attribution: revenue is copied as-is from the authoritative source, never recalculated, never summed with unrelated figures

cases.name: no unique MKT_ACCOUNTS match (unknown account) -> no pipeline write, unresolvedCount increments
cases.guarantee: never join by account name without an authoritative crosswalk; fail-closed on ambiguous/absent identity instead of guessing

cases.name: account present by name but missing salesforceAccountId/externalAccountId -> unresolved
cases.guarantee: canonical Salesforce Account ID or documented 1:1 mapping is mandatory before attribution writes anything

cases.name: existing pipeline record already has a campaignId and is past CAMPAIGN ACTIVE -> nextAction marks MULTI-CAMPAIGN CONCURRENCY, campaignId is not overwritten
cases.guarantee: attribution ambiguity is surfaced explicitly instead of silently reassigning campaign credit

cases.name: externalSystem='SALESFORCE_EXPORT' with a populated externalAccountId resolves salesforceAccountId and canonicalSalesforceIdStatus:'RESOLVED'
cases.guarantee: Canonical ID Bridge: the real, confirmed bug (exact-match 'SALESFORCE' gate silently leaving salesforceAccountId empty for real 'SALESFORCE_EXPORT' extracts) is fixed and reproduced exactly as reported

cases.name: account/contact with no externalAccountId/externalContactId stays canonicalSalesforceIdStatus:'UNRESOLVED', never fabricated
cases.guarantee: canonical Salesforce ID or a documented 1:1 mapping only; a missing identity is held, never guessed

cases.name: same SALESFORCE_EXPORT resolution/non-resolution pair for salesforceContactId
cases.guarantee: the fix applies identically to accounts and contacts, one shared helper, no divergent second code path

cases.name: non-Salesforce source (e.g. MANUAL_UPLOAD) never populates salesforceAccountId (regression: /SALESFORCE/ substring match must not become match-anything)
cases.guarantee: the more permissive substring match does not weaken the gate into accepting arbitrary sources

cases.name: v6AuraAuditCanonicalIds_ returns safe RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED/MISSING aggregate counts only, no accountName/email
cases.guarantee: AURA never surfaces PII through a read-only audit; MISSING (field never existed on the row) is distinguished from UNRESOLVED (field exists, explicitly unresolved)

cases.name: report source last modified 1h ago -> FRESH
cases.guarantee: a healthy, recently-refreshed source never blocks a Retention cycle

cases.name: report source last modified 10h ago -> STALE
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: AURA must not run a Retention campaign cycle against commercial data older than the six-hour cycle that consumes it

cases.name: just under the 6-hour threshold (5.9h) -> still FRESH
cases.guarantee: the threshold is the same six-hour constant as the existing opportunity-refresh trigger, not a new invented number, and the comparison is strictly greater-than

cases.name: DriveApp.getFileById is called with the real MKT_V6_REPORT_SOURCE_ID, not a fabricated id
cases.guarantee: the freshness check inspects the actual private report source, reusing the existing DriveApp dependency already used by MarketingV6DriveArchive.gs

cases.name: v6AuraRetentionDryRun_ STALE short-circuits before any report read
cases.guarantee: the pilot dry run inherits the same fail-closed freshness gate as evaluate; a stale-data pilot number is never produced

cases.name: v6AuraRetentionDryRun_ FRESH classifies synthetic accounts into every named category (detected, suppressedByAmActivity, suppressedByMissingAmContext, suppressedByDataQuality, reviewRequired, frequencyBlocked via the existing v6FrequencyStatus_, eligible, campaignScopesGenerated, recipientResolutionBlocked with an explicit un-guessed reason)
cases.guarantee: the pilot reuses v6AuraEvaluateRetention_ and v6FrequencyStatus_ verbatim (no duplicated suppression/frequency logic) and never invents a category outside the exact named set

cases.name: v6AuraDecisionFor_ — one assertion per branch across all 10 named decisions, plus 2 precedence-ordering checks
cases.guarantee: a pure, side-effect-free mapper always resolves to exactly one of the ten named decisions in the specified precedence order; a real pipeline stage always outranks a stale opportunity-level suppression label

cases.name: v6AuraGenerateAmCsvReport_ produces exactly the specified 30 columns, joins strictly by accountId, contains no email/phone, and lands in a distinct Drive folder from MKT_V6_ARCHIVE
cases.guarantee: AM-facing reporting never leaks contact PII and never joins by account name; campaign-execution archives and AM reports remain in separate private folders

cases.name: v6AuraWriteRunSummary_ / v6AuraRetentionRunSummary_ round-trip; unknown runId returns NOT FOUND rather than throwing
cases.guarantee: the persisted run summary is idempotent by runId (v6UpsertByKey_) and safely queryable without fabricating a result for an unknown run

cases.name: v6AuraRunRetentionCycle_ STALE produces no CSV and no summary row
cases.guarantee: the single scheduled orchestrator never hands AM a report generated from data it already knows is stale

cases.name: v6AuraRunRetentionCycle_ FRESH produces exactly one new CSV file and one persisted summary row referencing it
cases.guarantee: the full detect -> suppress -> scope -> AM CSV -> run summary cycle runs as one atomic, traceable unit per runId

cases.name: v6AuraEvaluateRetention_ aggregates DETECTED/SUPPRESSED/reviewRequired by reason and automatically builds campaign scope only for DETECTED accounts
cases.guarantee: detect -> suppress -> build scope runs as one automatic, no-manual-list unit; suppressed/review-required accounts are never scoped

cases.name: v6AuraAutoBuildRetentionScopes_ groups by (amOwner, service), excludes suppressed rows and other opportunity families
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention + family isolation: a Retention scope build can never include a non-Retention account or a suppressed Retention account

cases.name: v6AuraStatus_ returns safe consolidated status (pipeline stage, Retention signal, audience status once a campaign is linked); no PII fields
cases.guarantee: AURA never surfaces accountName/email/contact PII through a status query, only aggregate/status fields

cases.name: v6AuraEnsureCampaignScope_ is idempotent: re-running with an added account merges into the existing scope row, never duplicates it
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention: repeated scheduler runs against the same scope never create parallel scope/scope-account rows

cases.name: v6AuraCreateAccountStop_ closes a fresh account to CLOSED / SUPPRESSED; an account already at QUOTED keeps that stage (preventDowngrade) while nextAction/handoffStatus still update
cases.guarantee: account stop never erases evidence that a Quote/Load already happened, while still recording the stop/handoff intent

cases.name: v6AuraCreateAmHandoff_ preserves the account's current pipeline stage and refuses to run with no existing pipeline record
cases.guarantee: AM handoff never resets an already-advanced stage back to OPPORTUNITY DETECTED and never fabricates a pipeline context that doesn't exist

cases.name: v6ClassifyResponseEvent_ accepts QUOTE/LOAD as aliases of QUOTE_SIGNAL/LOAD_SIGNAL (case-insensitive) and only sets attributedRevenue on LOAD when the raw event explicitly supplies an amount
cases.guarantee: the exact event vocabulary requested (REPLY, RFQ, BOUNCE, UNSUBSCRIBE, CLICK, QUOTE, LOAD) is accepted without a second, divergent code path, and revenue is never fabricated on a real-time event

cases.name: (added Pass 4) freshness gate: STALE source blocks v6AuraEvaluateRetention_ before any write to MKT_OPPORTUNITIES/MKT_CAMPAIGN_SCOPES; FRESH source proceeds normally
cases.guarantee: fail-closed data freshness is enforced at the same entry point the scheduler calls, with zero side effects on STALE

cases.name: (added Pass 4) running v6AuraEvaluateRetention_ twice with identical input does not grow MKT_OPPORTUNITIES (full rewrite), MKT_CAMPAIGN_SCOPES, or MKT_SCOPE_ACCOUNTS (upsert by key)
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention / idempotency: repeated scheduler runs against the same data never accumulate duplicate rows in any of the three tables this cycle writes

cases.name: MKT_V6_DATA_HUB_ID or MKT_V6_REPORT_SOURCE_ID not openable -> BLOCKED_DATA_HUB_ACCESS returned immediately, nothing else runs
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: the bootstrap never attempts schema/folder/trigger/cycle work against a Data Hub it cannot even open

cases.name: MKT_RETENTION_RUN_SUMMARY tab auto-creates with the exact schema header row when it does not exist
cases.guarantee: the one table this pack is allowed to auto-create does so correctly, with headers read from the real schema constant, not duplicated by hand

cases.name: MKT_RETENTION_RUN_SUMMARY already exists with a header + data row -> v6AuraEnsureRunSummarySheet_ leaves it untouched (ALREADY_EXISTS, no clear/rewrite)
cases.guarantee: auto-creation is one-way and non-destructive: existing run-history data is never cleared or overwritten by the bootstrap

cases.name: running v6AuraBootstrapAndRun_ twice reuses the same Drive folder id (via the Script Property) and never creates a second folder
cases.guarantee: idempotency: the one-time Drive folder resolution never duplicates infrastructure on a repeated bootstrap run

cases.name: stored AURA_AM_REPORT_FOLDER_ID no longer resolves (DriveApp.getFolderById throws) -> falls back to a by-name lookup, then to creating a new folder only if no by-name match exists either; the Script Property is updated in both fallback branches
cases.guarantee: folder resolution degrades gracefully instead of hard-failing when the previously remembered folder was deleted, and never silently keeps pointing at a dead id

cases.name: freshness STALE -> v6AuraBootstrapAndRun_ returns BOOTSTRAP_BLOCKED_STALE_DATA with retentionCycle:null, while every step upstream of the freshness gate (schema, canonical ids, folder, trigger) still ran and is reported
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: no Retention cycle, no CSV, no run summary row is ever produced against data already known to be stale, even though the rest of the one-time setup still completes

cases.name: freshness FRESH -> v6AuraBootstrapAndRun_ returns BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETE with retentionCycle.status='CYCLE_COMPLETE' and both csvDriveFileId/handoffsCsvDriveFileId populated
cases.guarantee: the bootstrap's single call performs the full detect -> suppress -> scope -> AM CSV -> Handoffs CSV -> run summary cycle on a fresh source, with no manual follow-up step

cases.name: v6FetchAuthoritativeContactsFromSource_ does not exist anywhere in this pack (confirmed by source grep and by its absence in the loaded runtime context) -> contactIngestion reports SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED, bootstrap proceeds normally
cases.guarantee: no Salesforce/NOVA contact-pull integration is fabricated; the optional hook stays conditional and inert until DGL adds a real one

cases.name: v6InstallOpportunityRefreshTrigger_ (called inside the bootstrap) installs exactly one trigger on the first run and still exactly one trigger after a second bootstrap run
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention: repeated bootstrap runs never create a second, competing six-hour schedule

cases.name: router exposes v6AuraBootstrapAndRun -> v6AuraBootstrapAndRun_
cases.guarantee: the single one-time entry point is reachable the same way every other AURA route is, not a hidden/undocumented function

cases.name: (added Pass 7) freshness STALE_SOURCE -> exactly 2 triggers exist after the run (the always-installed canonical trigger plus one one-shot recovery trigger), a second STALE run does not add a third, and a subsequent FRESH run cleans the one-shot trigger back down to just the canonical one
cases.guarantee: self-healing recovery: a blocked run schedules a short-delay retry instead of waiting up to six hours, never duplicates that retry, and never leaves a stale recovery trigger installed once a real run succeeds

cases.name: (added Pass 7) a forced real exception thrown mid-bootstrap (e.g. from v6AuraAuditCanonicalIds_) is caught, returned as status RUN_FAILED with the real errorCode/errorMessage, durably logged as a RUN_FAILED row in MKT_AURA_RUN_LOG, and schedules a one-shot recovery trigger
cases.guarantee: no genuine runtime failure is ever swallowed or reported silently: the exact real Apps Script error is preserved end to end, both in the return value and in the durable native run log, with no fabricated diagnosis

cases.name: v6AuraLogStage_ upserts by (runId, stage): logging the same stage twice for one run updates the row instead of duplicating it; a different stage for the same run is a new row
cases.guarantee: the durable run log follows the same run_id/action-key idempotency convention as every other table in this codebase -- retries and re-logs never inflate the log

cases.name: v6AuraLogStage_ never throws even when the underlying upsert throws (e.g. a transient sheet-write failure)
cases.guarantee: self-observability is strictly best-effort: a logging failure can never break or mask the real business logic that called it

cases.name: v6AuraWriteLastRunStatusFile_ creates '_AURA_LAST_RUN_STATUS.json' once, then updates that same fixed-name file in place on every later call (never a second file), with only safe aggregate fields, no PII
cases.guarantee: the Drive-native status mirror stays a single always-current file, providing a cheap native alternative to Sheets REST access for verifying a run's outcome without ever accumulating history or leaking PII

cases.name: v6AuraScheduleOneShotBootstrapRecovery_ installs exactly one trigger, a second call while one is already pending returns ALREADY_PENDING and installs no second trigger, and v6AuraCleanupOneShotBootstrapRecovery_ removes it and clears the tracking Script Property (a second cleanup call safely reports NONE_PENDING)
cases.guarantee: the short-delay recovery mechanism is idempotent and self-cleaning by construction, matching the project's existing idempotent-trigger-install pattern

cases.name: cleanup removes only the tracked one-shot trigger id and leaves an unrelated pre-existing canonical trigger installed and untouched
cases.guarantee: the recovery mechanism can never accidentally delete the canonical six-hour scheduler trigger it was deliberately kept separate from

cases.name: every .gs/.md/.json file directly inside backend/apps-script-v6/, docs/, and the repo root contains zero email addresses outside a minimal, named allowlist (the single pre-existing synthetic QA fixture qa-synthetic@dglus.com)
cases.guarantee: GitHub stores code only: no customer/contact PII (email addresses) is ever committed to this public repo, checked by content scan (fs), not by trusting prior review alone

cases.name: the user's own commit-authorship email address never appears in the content of any tracked file in those locations, except MarketingV6AuraGmailIngest.gs (the DGL AM-report inbox address -- an approved operational identifier, not customer/contact PII, and not the author's identity)
cases.guarantee: author identity belongs only in git commit authorship metadata, never inside a committed file; the one narrow, named exception is a company mailbox address with a genuine functional need, not a leaked identity

cases.name: NOVA canonical source FRESH -> selected immediately, AM Intelligence Gmail source never even consulted
cases.guarantee: arbitration never does unnecessary work or second-guesses an already-fresh canonical source

cases.name: NOVA STALE, Gmail AM Intelligence source status OK / freshness CURRENT / rowsAccepted>0 -> AM_INTELLIGENCE_GMAIL selected, FRESH
cases.guarantee: root-cause fix: a real, already-validated, current AM report is no longer ignored just because the separate NOVA snapshot is stale

cases.name: rowsRejected>0 on the Gmail source does not block arbitration (no documented reject-rate policy exists anywhere in this codebase)
cases.guarantee: never invent a threshold that isn't documented -- only rowsAccepted>0 gates, rowsRejected is surfaced for visibility only

cases.name: NOVA STALE + Gmail present but freshness AGING (not CURRENT) -> STALE_SOURCE
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: the ingestion engine's own aging classification is honored, not loosened

cases.name: NOVA STALE + Gmail CURRENT but rowsAccepted=0 -> STALE_SOURCE
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: a report that produced zero usable rows never counts as a valid source

cases.name: NOVA STALE + Gmail NO_REPORT_RECEIVED -> STALE_SOURCE
cases.guarantee: fail-closed: no report ever received means no fallback source exists, full stop

cases.name: NOVA STALE + Gmail ingestion file not deployed at all (typeof-guarded) -> STALE_SOURCE, no crash
cases.guarantee: this codebase must not assume every deployment includes the Gmail ingestion file; its absence is a safe, non-fatal fallback to fail-closed

cases.name: v6RefreshOpportunitiesFromReports_ folds in v6BuildGmailOpportunities_ rows into MKT_OPPORTUNITIES alongside the five existing NOVA-sourced builders
cases.guarantee: closes the actual root-cause gap: a function that already existed and already claimed to do this was never actually wired in until now

cases.name: a Gmail-sourced Retention row and a NOVA-sourced QNB row for the SAME account (same accountId hash) are reconciled by the existing v6ApplyPrioritySuppression_ -- QNB wins, Gmail-Retention is SUPPRESSED / HIGHER PRIORITY SIGNAL
cases.guarantee: cross-source signals for one account never both stay active; the existing priority engine handles two sources exactly like it already handles two families from one source, no new mechanism

cases.name: building the queue for an eligible recipient produces exactly one real, personalized PENDING job (subject/htmlBody carry the real firstName/company, no unmerged {{token}})
cases.guarantee: real B2B personalization reusing the existing approved copy template verbatim, not a generic or fabricated email

cases.name: a non-ELIGIBLE MKT_AUDIENCES row (SUPPRESSED / review-required at the recipient-resolution layer) never reaches the queue
cases.guarantee: this file trusts v6ResolveRecipients_'s own suppression/frequency/DNC gate completely -- no parallel, second eligibility rule is ever invented here, so a reviewRequired or suppressed account can never be queued

cases.name: building the queue twice for the same campaign never rebuilds or duplicates an existing job, and never resets an already-SENT job back to PENDING
cases.guarantee: idempotent by deterministic jobId (campaignId+contactId+sequenceStep), matching the project's run_id/action-key convention; a later automatic tick can never silently undo a real send's terminal state

cases.name: a policy-review campaign (v6AuraPolicyApproved_ false) queues REVIEW_REQUIRED with an approvalId, never PENDING
cases.guarantee: approval is enforced before a job can ever reach the dispatcher's PENDING queue, reusing the existing policy engine unchanged

cases.name: DRY_RUN (the default when AURA_SEND_MODE is unset) runs every validation and writes the exact job that would be sent, but never calls GmailApp.sendEmail
cases.guarantee: the safe default: a fresh deployment can never send a real email until a human explicitly calls auraEnableLiveSending()

cases.name: LIVE mode actually calls GmailApp.sendEmail with the existing DGL_CONFIG.DEFAULT_SENDER_NAME identity, marks the job SENT, records a v6RecordMarketingTouch_ frequency-ledger touch and an MKT_TOUCHES row, and auraDisableLiveSending() switches back to DRY_RUN
cases.guarantee: going LIVE is a real, auditable, reversible, explicit action -- no invented sender alias, and the existing frequency/touch ledgers stay authoritative

cases.name: an active MKT_EXCLUSIONS row suppresses the job at dispatch time even though it was queued before the exclusion existed
cases.guarantee: suppression is re-checked at send time, not just at queue-build time, so a DNC/unsubscribe registered in between can never be bypassed by an already-queued job

cases.name: an account whose MKT_ACCOUNT_PIPELINE currentStage is RESPONDED is marked STOPPED and never sent
cases.guarantee: stopOnResponse / account-stop is enforced at the real send boundary, reusing v6PipelineAdvanced_ verbatim -- a customer who already replied can never receive a further automated send for that account

cases.name: a frequency-capped contact (v6FrequencyStatus_ eligible:false) is marked SKIPPED, never sent
cases.guarantee: frequency governance is re-checked at send time using the one real engine (v6FrequencyStatus_), not a duplicated or looser rule

cases.name: a second job for a (campaignId, accountId, contactId, sequenceStep) that already has a SENT row is marked SKIPPED / ALREADY_SENT_DUPLICATE and never sent, even under LIVE mode
cases.guarantee: duplicate prevention holds even if a job is ever queued under a second jobId for the same real-world send target -- no customer can ever receive the same touch twice from this dispatcher

cases.name: auraInstallTriggers() installs exactly one hourly dispatcher trigger; a second call reports TRIGGER_EXISTS and never installs a duplicate
cases.guarantee: the dispatcher's own trigger is idempotent and kept strictly separate from the canonical hourly Acquisition/AURA tick and the 6-hour Retention bootstrap trigger

regressionCoverage.description: Full suite re-run after every change in this branch, most recently after adding the real Gmail send provider for Retention (Pass 8: MarketingV6AuraEmailDispatcher.gs, DRY_RUN/LIVE AURA_SEND_MODE, MKT_EMAIL_QUEUE built from the existing eligible audience). All previously-recorded pre-existing failures (7 files, unrelated V5.5/legacy frontend assertions, see history below) remain absent from the current tree -- the full suite is green.
regressionCoverage.history: Pass 4's regression run recorded 24 files / 17 passed / 7 failed, with the 7 failures independently reproduced on main via git stash (stale index.html cache-busting version strings and V5.5 frontend/backend-adapter assertions unrelated to any Retention V1 file). As of Pass 5/6/7/8's runs (node --test tests/*.test.js), all 7 of those previously-failing files pass; nothing in any of these passes touched any of them, so no fix was authored here -- this note only records that the full suite is currently green end to end (35 files carried forward + 1 new this pass: tests/v6-aura-email-dispatcher.test.js; tests/v6-aura-bootstrap.test.js and tests/v6-schema-migration.test.js fixtures were extended in place, not added, to seed the two newly schema-tracked legacy tables MKT_EMAIL_QUEUE/MKT_TOUCHES).
